# appsignal_log_source (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing log source of an app by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get a log source of an app by name
data "appsignal_log_source" "example" {
  app_id = "abcdef"
  name   = "application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app the log source belongs to. Must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the log source. Log source names are unique within an app.

### Read-Only

- `fmt` (String) The format of the log source.
- `id` (String) The ID of the log source.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The API key used for the log source.
- `type` (String) The type of the log source.
